youtube.title: 7. Union: in A or in B
youtube.body:
Union is not two boxes glued together. It is a third set: you are in it if you are in A or in B.

Lean keeps Set α and hangs ∪ through the Union typeclass. Set.union is the “or” predicate; mem_union only unfolds it. Turn-Lang names Union and writes law def — later proofs look up unfold Union.def.

Episode 7 of Abstract Algebra in a Proof Assistant.
